extracted.intended_audience: Member delegations of the Lisbon Union, WIPO Member States, WIPO Secretariat, and other stakeholders in the Lisbon System (appellations of origin and geographical indications)
extracted.subtask_description: Report of the Working Group on the Development of the Lisbon System recommending specific procedural and regulatory amendments to the Common Regulations and identifying follow-up work (rules on refusal/withdrawal/grant, additional requirements under Article 7(4)/Rule 5(3), and adoption of Special Rules of Procedure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitional measure for election of officers
rubrics_metrics.description: The Working Group adopted a transitional measure consisting of electing officers to preside over both its sixth and seventh sessions, to align the election cycle of its officers with Rule 9 of the General Rules of Procedure of WIPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure adopted to align election cycle with WIPO Rule 9; the Group elected a Chair and two Vice-Chairs under this transitional measure and agreed to elect officers in accordance with Rule 9 from its seventh session.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of Special Rules of Procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: The Working Group adopted the Special Rules of Procedure, as presented in the Annex to document LI/WG/DEV-SYS/6/2, for their entry into force upon their adoption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special Rules of Procedure were adopted for immediate entry into force upon adoption; text of the Rules is in the Annex to the referenced document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed amendments to Rule 1(1) of the Common Regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Working Group recommended to the Assembly the adoption of the proposed amendments to Rule 1(1) of the Common Regulations as presented in the Annex to document LI/WG/DEV-SYS/6/3 Rev.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendation submitted to the Assembly; detailed amendment text appears in the referenced Annex and in document LI/A/42/2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed amendments to Rules 8, 15 and 18 of the Common Regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: The Working Group recommended the adoption of the proposed amendments to Rules 8, 15 and 18 of the Common Regulations as amended by the Working Group (see paragraph 15 of document LI/WG/DEV-SYS/6/4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments as amended by the Working Group are presented in document LI/A/42/2; recommendation is for Assembly adoption to increase clarity and legal certainty of Lisbon procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Further consideration of amendments to Rule 9 (Refusal), Rule 11 (Withdrawal of Refusal) and Rule 12 (Grant of Protection)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Working Group agreed to continue its discussions, at the next session, on the proposed amendments to Rule 9 (Refusal), Rule 11 (Withdrawal of Refusal) and Rule 12 (Grant of Protection) of the Common Regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issues on refusal, withdrawal of refusal and grant of protection remain under discussion and will be revisited at the next Working Group session (see paragraph 16 of LI/WG/DEV-SYS/6/4).

rubrics_metrics.name: Streamline/simplify procedures for additional requirements under Article 7(4) and Rule 5(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Roundtable stimulated exchanges on ways to further streamline and simplify the procedures relating to additional requirements under Article 7(4) of the Geneva Act and Rule 5(3) of the Common Regulations, particularly through possible changes of key features of the Lisbon System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discussions referenced the new Lisbon IT platform (eLisbon); agenda and presentations from the Roundtable are available on the meeting’s webpage. The focus is on procedural simplification and potential changes to key system features.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secretariat to prepare procedures/options document on Article 7(4)/Rule 5(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Working Group invited the Secretariat to prepare a document on the procedures relating to additional requirements under Article 7(4) of the Geneva Act and Rule 5(3) of the Common Regulations, including background information and possible options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Secretariat tasked to produce background and options material to inform future discussions and potential amendments (see paragraph 19 of LI/WG/DEV-SYS/6/4).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assembly to take note of the Working Group report
rubrics_metrics.description: The Assembly of the Lisbon Union is invited to take note of the 'Report on the Working Group on the Development of the Lisbon System' (document LI/A/42/1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal notification/invitation for the Assembly to record the report; no scoring guidance — procedural step in governance.
